switch.text: if the loop needs a fix

div.div:
reports every problem,
fixed or not

next runs use
the fixed loop

Every problem reaches Root.An agent reports every problem it hits with a tool, skill, script, automation, CI, relay or machine setup to its orchestrator, fixed or not. The orchestrator records it in problems.jsonl (an agent may record it itself with the helper). Unfixed ones also go in needs_root. Root reads the new lines on each tick, acts on the unfixed ones, and lists the day's problems, fixed and unfixed, in the end-of-day summary. A loop fix ships as a PR to the loop's own repo through the same gate; workflow fixes reach every repo when the v0 tag moves; skill fixes ship as a plugin update. Nazar's only steps: approve and merge.
Example:factory-loop #16 and #14, review-job fixes raised by an agent from forge-cli PRs: a false red review check, and review runs that stopped early. Both were merged and rolled out via v0; after #14, the next review on forge-cli #42 passed.

div.div:
Stageis a field on the org Project board “Crucible Loop”; an item can also beparked.
Agents never push to main and never merge. Product releases (npm, brew, scoop) stay manual.
